headlines.title: 三张反对票齐现 美联储内部加息压力升温
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月30日讯，在本次利率决议中，联邦公开市场委员会中的五位地区联储主席票委里，有三人投下反对票，分别是克利夫兰联储主席哈马克、明尼阿波利斯联储主席卡什卡利以及达拉斯联储主席洛根。三人一致主张加息25个基点。这是自2016年9月以来，美联储首次在同一次政策决议中出现三张方向一致的反对票，反映出美联储内部支持收紧政策的声音正在增强。支持维持利率不变的美联储主席沃什一直强调，美联储有责任遏制通胀。预计他将在北京时间凌晨2:30的新闻发布会上，被问及为何认为继续保持耐心仍是当前最合适的政策选择。

headlines.title_en: Three dissenting votes appear, intensifying pressure for a Fed rate hike.
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 30 - At this rate decision, three of the five regional Fed bank presidents on the FOMC dissented: Cleveland Fed President Hammack, Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari, and Dallas Fed President Logan. All three voted for a 25-basis-point rate hike. This is the first time since September 2016 that the Fed has seen three dissenting votes in the same policy decision, indicating growing internal support for tightening. Fed Chair Warsh, who favored holding rates steady, has stressed the Fed's duty to curb inflation. He is expected to be asked at the 02:30 Beijing time press conference why patience remains the most appropriate policy for now.

headlines.title: 近十年主动ETF规模年均复合增长率达44%
headlines.summary: 从全球市场发展态势来看，主动ETF已成为资产管理行业的重要增长引擎。截至2026年3月底，全球ETF市场总规模19.9万亿美元，其中被动ETF 17.8万亿美元，占比89.4%；主动ETF 2.1万亿美元，占比10.6%。近十年主动ETF规模年均复合增长率高达44%，显著高于全量ETF的19%。易方达基金相关人士表示，首批18只主动股票ETF近日上报，有望为A股注入可观增量资金。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Active ETF assets under management have grown at a compound annual growth rate of 44% over the past decade.
headlines.summary_en: From a global market perspective, active ETFs have become a key growth engine for the asset management industry. As of end-March 2026, total global ETF market size was $19.9 trillion, including $17.8 trillion in passive ETFs (89.4%) and $2.1 trillion in active ETFs (10.6%). Over the past decade, active ETF assets have grown at a 44% CAGR, significantly higher than the 19% for total ETFs. A source from E Fund said the first batch of 18 active equity ETFs was recently filed, potentially bringing substantial incremental funds to A-shares. (The Paper)

headlines.title_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission: Focus on enhancing enterprise technological innovation capabilities and strengthening collaborative efforts on key core technologies.
headlines.summary_en: From July 28 to 29, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) held a seminar with heads of local SASACs in Beijing to summarize work, exchange experiences, and plan tasks for the second half of the year. The meeting stressed that a solid performance in H2 state-owned enterprise (SOE) work should focus on formulating and implementing the '15th Five-Year Plan' and advancing a new round of SOE reforms as key drivers. Priorities include high-quality steady growth, sustained efficiency improvement, expanding effective investment, driving collaborative development with upstream and downstream firms, bolstering national economic and industrial security; enhancing enterprise tech innovation, joint breakthroughs in core technologies, commercializing research, refining mechanisms supporting innovation, and raising supply chain security.

headlines.summary: 【上海市发改委：拟于9月召开优化轨道交通票价机制听证会】上海市发展和改革委员会7月29日发布公告：拟于2026年9月7日组织召开优化上海市轨道交通票价机制听证会，该票价机制适用于全市轨道交通，不含磁浮线、金山铁路、市域机场线及以后开通的市域线。本次听证会参加人由下列人员组成：消费者12名，市消费者权益保护委员会1名，市人大代表1名，市政协委员1名，专家、学者2名，市交通运输行业协会1名，市国资委1名，市财政局1名，久事集团1名，申通地铁集团2名，共计23名。消费者参加人通过自愿报名、随机选取的方式产生，委托市消费者权益保护委员会受理报名和随机选取确定人选；如报名人数不足12名时，委托市消保委推荐产生。市消保委参加人、市人大代表参加人、市政协委员参加人、专家学者参加人、政府部门参加人由市价格主管部门邀请；行业协会参加人、久事集团参加人、申通地铁集团参加人由市价格主管部门委托行业主管部门推荐。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Development and Reform Commission: Plans to hold a hearing in September to optimize rail transit fare mechanisms.
headlines.summary_en: [Shanghai Development and Reform Commission: Hearing on optimizing rail transit fare mechanisms to be held in September] The Shanghai Municipal Development and Reform Commission announced on July 29 that it plans to hold a hearing on September 7, 2026 to optimize Shanghai's rail transit fare mechanism. The mechanism applies to all city rail transit, excluding the maglev line, Jinshan Railway, Airport Link line, and future municipal lines. The hearing panel will comprise 12 consumers, 1 from the Shanghai Consumer Council, 1 NPC deputy, 1 CPPCC member, 2 experts/scholars, 1 from the Shanghai Transport Industry Association, 1 from the Shanghai SASAC, 1 from the Shanghai Finance Bureau, 1 from Jiushi Group, and 2 from Shentong Metro Group, totaling 23. Consumers will be selected through voluntary registration and random drawing, handled by the Shanghai Consumer Council; if fewer than 12 register, the council will recommend candidates. Other participants will be invited by the pricing authority.
